_comment: LinesOfAction locale file. DO NOT translate keys (left side). Only translate values (right side). Never translate board coordinates (a-h, 1-8), piece letters (O, X), the move-format token, or the {board} ASCII grid.

_slots.{side}: The player's piece letter, either O or X
_slots.{other}: The opponent's piece letter, either O or X
_slots.{board}: The ASCII rendering of the board; keep as-is
_slots.{coord}: A board coordinate such as b1 or a3
_slots.{from}: The source coordinate of a move, such as b1
_slots.{to}: The destination coordinate of a move, such as b3

player_prompt.intro:
Uri mugenzi {player_id} mu mukino wa LinesOfAction.
Ibipimo vyawe ni '{side}', ibipimo vya mwenzi ni '{other}'.
Mfumo wa kwimuka: `[b1b3]` (kutoka-muhimili hadi-muhimili).  Kwimuka kwa sheria kwagera mbali, juu, chini, au diagonale kuva kwa idadi ya miraba sawa na jumla ya bipimo (ivyo vyote) kuriya mstari. Urashobora kuruka hejuru ya bipimo vyawe, lakini si bipimo vya mwenzi; kugera kuri bipimo vya mwenzi vyakukamata.  Ushindi wakati bipimo vyawe vyote vimewekwa pamoja kwa kuwa karibu.

invalid_move.wrong_format: Uburyo bwo gutora butegerezwa kuba e2e4 (kuva,gushika ku migwi y'ubuyobozi).
invalid_move.identical: Aho bavuye n'aho baja ni bimwe.
invalid_move.not_straight_or_diagonal: Ugukwiragira gukwiye kuba gutumbereye canke ku ruhande.
invalid_move.wrong_distance: Ugomba kugenda umbali unaolingana na ibuye mu mstari.

game_action.captured_suffix: Umukinnyi {player_id} yarakinye {from} -> {to} akoresheje umukinnyi wa musuhu.

outcome.draw_no_capture: Imigwi 60 iriko iragenda ata n'umwe aronse.
